Comfy-Org/ComfyUI — v0.37.0
items.content:
## What's Changed
* Aimdo 0.5.5 + Auto-detect and enable --fast-disk when the disk is fast (CORE-440) by @rattus128 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16333
* [Partner Nodes] feat(OpenAI): add transparent background support for GPT Image 2 by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16366
* Add CFG control to YuE2 Generate Music node. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16373
* Always put text encoder on GPU when dynamic vram on. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16374
* [Partner Nodes] fix(Tripo): refuse a P2 run whose linked GLB or FBX output would be empty by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16369
* feat: Support MoGe 3 (CORE-443) by @kijai in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16381
* Update comfy-kitchen version to 0.2.35 by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16385
* chores: Update default width and height in EmptyLatentImage by @alexisrolland in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16384
* chores: Update nodes names and categories by @alexisrolland in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16274
* Qwen3/3.5/3.8 cudagraphs and w4a8 gemv support (CORE-390) by @kijai in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15623
* Fix issue with qwen speedup PR. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16389
* Lower the pos embed precision of SheetSage2 to match upstream. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16395
* [Partner Nodes] feat(client): send Idempotency-Key on partner-proxy calls and collect replays by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16220
* Bump comfyui-frontend-package to 1.53.6 by @comfy-pr-bot in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16386
* Fix ace step VAE decode crashing on non bf16 GPUs. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16405
* feat: Qwen-image 2.1 support (CORE-423) by @kijai in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16400
* Update embedded docs to v0.5.12 by @comfyui-wiki in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16396
* Lower wan peak vram when using comfy kitchen attention. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16418
* Update workflow templates to v0.11.65 by @comfyui-wiki in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16423
* Add a way to disable fast disk for debugging. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16424
* Update workflow templates to v0.11.66 by @comfyui-wiki in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16426
* [Partner Nodes] feat(Meshy): add Meshy 7.1 support by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16412
* Fix MiniMax Music 3 producing noise with CUDA graphs enabled. by @RaynoldVanHeyningen in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16428

## New Contributors
* @RaynoldVanHeyningen made their first contribution in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16428

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/compare/v0.36.0...v0.37.0

items.title: browser-use/browser-use — 0.13.10
items.content:
## Browser Use 0.13.10

- Upgrade Browser Harness to 0.1.13.
- Exact-pin all declared runtime, optional, development, and build dependencies.
- Upgrade and migrate to MCP Python SDK 2.1.1.
- Add pydantic-settings 2.15.0 as an explicit runtime dependency.
- Pin Pydantic 2.13.5 and Hatchling 1.32.0.
- Upgrade pypdf to 6.16.2, resolving the three current pypdf Dependabot advisories.
- Report unknown MCP tool calls as application errors instead of successful results.

Validation includes the full GitHub test matrix, model adapters, MCP stdio handshakes, cross-platform wheel installation, focused PDF tests, CodeQL, GitGuardian, and an installed-runtime vulnerability audit.

items.title: unclecode/crawl4ai — Release v0.9.4
items.content:
## 🎉 Crawl4AI v0.9.4 Released!

### 📦 Installation

**PyPI:**
```bash
pip install crawl4ai==0.9.4
```

**Docker:**
```bash
docker pull unclecode/crawl4ai:0.9.4
docker pull unclecode/crawl4ai:latest
```

**Note:** Docker images are being built and will be available shortly.
Check the [Docker Release workflow](https://github.com/unclecode/crawl4ai/actions/workflows/docker-release.yml) for build status.

### 📝 What's Changed
See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/unclecode/crawl4ai/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for details.

analysis.why_it_matters: 该话题属于地理/资源与区域发展议题，与 DSIH / Dream Stream 的 AI 视频生成、工作流与智能体方向没有直接关联；且仅凭一个提问标题无法核实所谓『大型地下水水源』的真实性与规模。

analysis.summary: 该条目仅为 B 站搜索页链接，关键词为“星铁真珠角色PV”，没有任何正文、作者或发布时间信息，无法确认具体视频内容。
analysis.why_it_matters: 这是《崩坏：星穹铁道》角色 PV 的搜索入口，属于游戏/二次元宣传内容，与 AI 视频生成技术或 Dream Stream 工作流无直接关联。

analysis.summary: ComfyUI 发布 v0.37.0，包含自动启用 fast-disk、Qwen-image 2.1/MoGe 3/Meshy 7.1 等新模型支持、MiniMax Music 3 CUDA 图修复、Wan 显存优化、工作流模板与前端更新。
analysis.why_it_matters: ComfyUI 是 DSIH/Dream Stream 的核心工作流引擎；该版本提升模型兼容性、显存与运行稳定性，并更新模板，可能直接影响 AI 视频/图像管线。

analysis.summary: browser-use 发布 0.13.10：升级 Browser Harness 至 0.1.13，精确锁定所有运行时/可选/开发/构建依赖，迁移到 MCP Python SDK 2.1.1，新增 pydantic-settings 运行时依赖，并修复 pypdf 安全通告；未知 MCP 工具调用现在会作为应用错误上报。
analysis.why_it_matters: 该项目处于 Agent、浏览器自动化与 MCP 集成交叉点，版本更新涉及依赖安全、MCP 兼容性和错误处理可靠性，对 Dream Stream 的 Agent/Skill/MCP 工作流有直接参考和维护价值。

analysis.summary: ComfyUI 发布 v0.37.0，更新包含 Aimdo 0.5.5 与自动启用 --fast-disk、OpenAI GPT Image 2 透明背景支持、YuE2 音乐节点 CFG 控制、动态 VRAM 下文本编码器常驻 GPU、MoGe 3 支持、Qwen3/3.5/3.8 cudagraphs 与 w4a8 gemv 支持、Qwen-image 2.1 支持、降低 Wan 使用 comfy kitchen attention 时的峰值显存、修复 MiniMax Music 3 在 CUDA graphs 下产生噪声，以及工作流模板更新等。
analysis.why_it_matters: 这是 ComfyUI 官方版本发布，项目与 DSIH/Dream Stream 关注的 ComfyUI、AI 视频/图像工作流、Wan、MiniMax、Qwen 等方向高度相关。若后续升级采用该版本，可能改善显存占用、模型支持与运行稳定性；但该条目本身只说明上游发布了哪些改动，不代表 DSIH/Dream Stream 已集成或依赖这些更新。

items.title: browser-use/browser-use — 0.13.10
items.content:
## Browser Use 0.13.10

- Upgrade Browser Harness to 0.1.13.
- Exact-pin all declared runtime, optional, development, and build dependencies.
- Upgrade and migrate to MCP Python SDK 2.1.1.
- Add pydantic-settings 2.15.0 as an explicit runtime dependency.
- Pin Pydantic 2.13.5 and Hatchling 1.32.0.
- Upgrade pypdf to 6.16.2, resolving the three current pypdf Dependabot advisories.
- Report unknown MCP tool calls as application errors instead of successful results.

Validation includes the full GitHub test matrix, model adapters, MCP stdio handshakes, cross-platform wheel installation, focused PDF tests, CodeQL, GitGuardian, and an installed-runtime vulnerability audit.

